outputs.name: Effective Skill Tier
outputs.description: Skill Tier clamped to 0-6 for this preview. Overcharge is excluded.

outputs.name: Cooldown factor (× base)
outputs.description: Relative cooldown factor from Skill Haste plus Skill Efficiency, counted once each. Uses the inverse-speed estimate: 100% combined haste halves cooldown. A nonpositive speed factor yields zero. No base cooldown is applied; excludes skill-specific tier cooldown scaling, mods, Expertise, timing, resets and overcharge.

outputs.name: Estimated Damage
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE estimate from Skill List!C88:J88 (TU27 workbook). Base 26,545; uses the selected tier curve, modeled bonuses and skill amplification. Source values and stacking need live-game verification. Excludes unreviewed skill mods, Overcharge, target armor/health/out-of-cover bonuses, resistances, DPS and unmodeled procs. Existing current-buff assumptions apply to both skill previews. Installed Expertise adds 1 percentage point per grade to the tier damage pool, separately from global Skill Damage. Effect source: Skill Info!R20:R21. This aggregation is a community-based inference requiring live-game verification. Generic damage upgrades do not change separate Burn/Bleed channels; the explicitly sourced Burn Sticky upgrade changes Burn only. The fixed observed damage mod adds to this ordinary tier pool only. Other skills and global stats are unaffected; stacking with Expertise remains an estimate.
outputs.formula: 26545 * (1 + curve('skill_assault_turret_damage_tiers', min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier)))) + skill_mod_damage + skill_upgrade_rank * 0.01) * max(0, 1 + effective_skill_damage) * max(0, 1 + total_skill_damage) * skill_damage_multiplier

outputs.name: Estimated Ordinary Cooldown (s)
outputs.description: Community level-40 ordinary PvE cooldown reference from Skill List!C85:J85 (TU27 workbook). Base 25s, divided by one plus Skill Haste and Skill Efficiency counted once. Only explicitly reviewed tier Skill Haste enters the additive haste pool; dashed entries contribute zero. Nonpositive speed yields zero as an invalid-boundary estimate, not readiness. Excludes charge refill, skill mods, skill Expertise, Overcharge, timers, use/cancellation/destruction, deployment delays and actual resets. Existing conditional reset capability remains separate. Source baselines and stacking require live verification.

outputs.name: Estimated Skill Health
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE skill-health reference from Skill List!C87:J87 (TU27 workbook). Tier curve follows the retained source cells; Skill Health plus Skill Efficiency adds once, independently of damage, repair and player armor/health. Armor cores and shield-specific Health do not scale this variant. This is capacity, not current health, mitigation, regeneration or destruction prediction. No unreviewed skill mods, skill Expertise, Overcharge or combat events. Source values and bonus stacking need live verification. The fixed observed health mod adds to this ordinary tier pool only. Other skills and global stats are unaffected; stacking with Expertise remains an estimate.
outputs.formula: 1061796 * max(0, (1 + curve('skill_assault_turret_skill_health_tiers', min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier)))) + skill_mod_health)) * max(0, 1 + effective_skill_health)

outputs.name: Estimated Duration Reference (s)
outputs.description: Community level-40 PvE duration reference from Skill List!C86:J86 (TU27 workbook). Source tier duration and Combined Skill Duration (Skill Efficiency once). Legal permanent Nanite duration reductions apply only to reviewed healing variants. A source duration capacity estimate, not time remaining, fuel/ammo consumption, health-based survival, uptime, talent-buff duration or DPS. No unreviewed skill mods, skill Expertise or Overcharge. Source values and stacking require live verification. Fixed observed same-effect mods add locally before the existing separate gear factors. No new roll range, Overcharge or installed Expertise stacking is asserted.

outputs.name: Installed Expertise Damage Bonus Reference
outputs.description: Installed grade on this exact variant, 0-30. Source Skill Info!R20:R21 (TU27): +1% Damage per grade. Estimated effect included in: Estimated Damage. Does not simulate proficiency, account eligibility or upgrade costs. This is the source increment, not a separate multiplier on the final estimate or a claim about caps.

outputs.name: Assumed Damage per Burst
outputs.description: Ordinary damage per shot with your burst timings. All shots land on one target. Excludes Overcharge, targeting, deployment and redeployment time.
outputs.formula: (26545 * (1 + curve('skill_assault_turret_damage_tiers', min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier)))) + skill_mod_damage + skill_upgrade_rank * 0.01) * max(0, 1 + effective_skill_damage) * max(0, 1 + total_skill_damage) * skill_damage_multiplier) * context_value('assault_turret_burst_shots')

outputs.name: Assumed Firing DPS
outputs.description: Ordinary damage per shot with your burst timings. All shots land on one target. Excludes Overcharge, targeting, deployment and redeployment time.
outputs.formula: ((26545 * (1 + curve('skill_assault_turret_damage_tiers', min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier)))) + skill_mod_damage + skill_upgrade_rank * 0.01) * max(0, 1 + effective_skill_damage) * max(0, 1 + total_skill_damage) * skill_damage_multiplier) * context_value('assault_turret_burst_shots')) / context_value('assault_turret_burst_seconds')

outputs.name: Assumed Burst-Cycle DPS
outputs.description: Ordinary damage per shot with your burst timings. All shots land on one target. Excludes Overcharge, targeting, deployment and redeployment time.
outputs.formula: ((26545 * (1 + curve('skill_assault_turret_damage_tiers', min(6, max(0, floor(skill_tier)))) + skill_mod_damage + skill_upgrade_rank * 0.01) * max(0, 1 + effective_skill_damage) * max(0, 1 + total_skill_damage) * skill_damage_multiplier) * context_value('assault_turret_burst_shots')) / (context_value('assault_turret_burst_seconds') + context_value('assault_turret_pause_seconds'))

outputs.description: Damage per use averaged over the skill's cooldown cycle: impact damage plus its rate for its window, divided by the time between uses (the cooldown, or the window plus the cooldown when it starts at the end). One target; excludes Overcharge, deployment time and charges.

assumptions.name: Target Out of Cover
assumptions.description: Whether the selected enemy is out of cover, so Damage to Targets Out of Cover applies to weapon damage in the target estimates. Off by default.

assumptions.name: Practical Hit Rate (%)
assumptions.description: Share of shots that hit, for practical weapon DPS. Starts at 70%; an editable reference, not a measured accuracy.

assumptions.name: Headshots among Hits (%)
assumptions.description: Share of the hits that land on the head, for practical weapon DPS. Starts at 25%.

assumptions.name: Breadbasket Stacks
assumptions.description: Assumed current bonus stacks for the next headshot (0-3; Perfect Breadbasket caps at 2). Body-shot stack generation, next-headshot consumption, and the 10s timer are not simulated. This adds only the Headshot Damage stat bonus; it is not applied to the regular weapon-card preview.

assumptions.name: Striker's Gamble Stacks
assumptions.description: Assumed currently retained Striker's Gamble stacks (0-200). The cap is 100 without the Press the Advantage host equipped and talent selected, or 200 with it. Weapon-hit stack generation and stack decay are not simulated.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Damage Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge damage for selected damaging skills. Does not activate Overcharge or change ordinary previews. Utility, healing, cooldowns, timers, proc eligibility and DPS are excluded. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Lifetime Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge deployment, cloud or effect-lifetime references for selected reviewed variants. Source lifetime only; no time remaining, status duration, recipient buff duration, uptime or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Health Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge device, shield, zone or foam health capacity for selected reviewed variants. No current health, survival, damage taken or shield invulnerability. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Overcharge Recovery Comparison
assumptions.description: 0 hides the comparison; 1 shows hypothetical Overcharge ordinary cooldown or single-ammo recovery estimates for selected reviewed variants. No Hive refill, charge speed, current timer, full refill, actual readiness or activation. View setting only; not saved or shared.

assumptions.name: Assault Turret Shots per Burst
assumptions.description: Assumed landed shots per burst. Starts at the recorded 20-shot reference; timing stays editable.

assumptions.name: Assault Turret Firing Time (s)
assumptions.description: Assumed seconds spent firing one burst. Starts at the approximately 5-second recorded reference.

assumptions.name: Assault Turret Burst Pause (s)
assumptions.description: Assumed pause between bursts, including reload. The 1-second starting value is the recorded upper-bound reference; deployment and redeployment are excluded.

assumptions.name: Enemy Target Profile
assumptions.description: Enemy for target estimates. Profiles group game-file NPC declarations by role, health base and armor base, labelled with the factions that use them most. Named entries are a sample of named bosses, one per main faction, with the mission whose scripts reference them; whether they spawn there with these values, and with which role override, is not established.

assumptions.name: Enemy Group Size
assumptions.description: Number of players the enemy is scaled for.

assumptions.name: Enemy Hit Rate (%)
assumptions.description: Share of the enemy's shots that hit you, for time to armor break. Starts at a flat 50%; Shade-Tech in-game counts found about 70% within 15 m and 30% beyond for a normal enemy.

assumptions.name: Enemies Attacking
assumptions.description: Enemies of the selected target firing at you at once.

assumptions.name: Enemy Firing Time (%)
assumptions.description: Share of the time the enemy spends firing. Enemies fire in bursts, move and reload, with pauses that the game data does not yet describe; testers judge they fire under half the time, so it starts at 50% (G428). 100% is continuous fire.
